other_conditions: Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must be a registered woman construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka
Must be pregnant at the time of application
Assistance is only for the first two deliveries
Registration must be renewed every 3 years, with a 1‑year grace period
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 for each of the first two deliveries.
